texts.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通美食，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的甜品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
texts.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.
